answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 155489 Country: India Title: Please let me know wazifah, dua for a suitable job for my son who is unemployed. Question: Please let me know wazifah, dua for a suitable job for my son who is unemployed. Answer ID: 155489 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 94/91/SD=2/1439) After Maghrib salah recite Surah al-Waqia regularly. Also read Ya Mughni ( يا مغني ) 1111 times after Isha salah with durood 11-11 times before and after. Also read the following dua after fardh salah regularly: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
